component.purpose: V16.4 §4 sélecteur de stratégie — choose NATIVE / HYBRID / PROVIDER / DECISION_REQUIRED from canonical evidence; §7 hybrid gap
invariants: chooses only: AUTHORIZES nothing, LAUNCHES nothing, calls no model and no provider
every input is evidence-cited or NOT_MEASURED; NOT_MEASURED is never default-filled and raises uncertainty
provider ⇒ authorizationRequired always; budgetRequired unless a verifiable budget object; providerExecutable needs budget AND bound OWNER authorization; launchedBySelector=false
HYBRID only when decomposable (planner DECOMPOSED + ≥2 parts with independent checks) AND write-sets disjoint (UNKNOWN ⇒ conflict) AND ≥1 local + ≥1 delegated part
strategy change only on an ODG stop; never repeats a tried strategy; bounded by MAX_CHAIN; PURE/deterministic/frozen

rules: Q1 a part with an OBSERVED local ACCEPT (same contract) ⇒ QUALIFIED_OBSERVED (model = the accepting model)
Q2 a part with OBSERVED local failures only ⇒ QUALIFIED_MEASURED if the registry has a QUALIFIED model strictly larger than every model tried, else NOT_QUALIFIED_OBSERVED
Q2b a mission-level local failure that no part-level observation localises counts as an observed failure of every part (PROVIDER only after an OBSERVED local failure on that task/part)

Q3 no part observation ⇒ class registry via chooseExecutionPolicy measured overlay (selectMeasured): LOCAL ⇒ QUALIFIED_MEASURED; NO_QUALIFIED_LOCAL_MODEL with a PROBATION model ⇒ PROBATION_PROBE (€0 local probe first, escalate-after-failure — weak evidence is never treated harsher than none); NO_QUALIFIED without PROBATION ⇒ NOT_QUALIFIED_MEASURED; UNAVAILABLE ⇒ UNAVAILABLE; absent taskClass / unusable registry ⇒ NOT_MEASURED
Q4 NOT_MEASURED is never default-filled: it is treated as a €0 local PROBE (canonical policy PROBE tier) and raises uncertainty to HIGH
M0 mission.authorizationState supplied and ≠ AUTHORIZED ⇒ DECISION_REQUIRED (the selector never authorizes); the evidence-derived choice is reported as tentativeMode
M1 risk HIGH ⇒ authorizationRequired for every mode; risk HIGH with uncertainty HIGH ⇒ DECISION_REQUIRED
M2 whole mission observed ACCEPTED locally, or every part LOCAL_OK (QUALIFIED_* or NOT_MEASURED probe) ⇒ NATIVE (€0)
M3 a supplied deadline shorter than the measured local wall time ⇒ DECISION_REQUIRED (speed vs paid-provider trade-off is an owner decision)

M4 ≥1 LOCAL_OK part AND ≥1 non-local part AND decomposable (planner DECOMPOSED + ≥2 parts each with an independent check) AND write-sets disjoint (odg-writeset-contention, UNKNOWN ⇒ conflict) ⇒ HYBRID: local parts native, others via delegation records, ODG integrates + independent validation
M5 otherwise (some part not locally qualified) ⇒ PROVIDER: one deny-by-default delegation RECORD (CREATED); HYBRID refused reasons are reported
C1 local cost = €0 (loopback Ollama); provider cost = UNKNOWN unless a verifiable budget {currency, ceiling>0, enforcedBy, evidenceRef} is supplied ⇒ budgetRequired
C2 a provider part ALWAYS has authorizationRequired=true; providerExecutable only with a verifiable budget AND an OWNER authorization bound to this mission id; the selector NEVER launches a provider
U1 uncertainty HIGH if any part qualification is NOT_MEASURED; else MEDIUM if risk is NOT_MEASURED or a multi-part write-set is UNKNOWN; else LOW
F0..F7 strategy change on failure: see nextStrategyAfterFailure (ODG stop only; never repeats a tried strategy; bounded by MAX_CHAIN)

criteria.name: PROVIDER_NEVER_EXECUTABLE_WITHOUT_BUDGET_AND_AUTHORIZATION
criteria.test: every selection whose mode or tentativeMode is PROVIDER/HYBRID has authorizationRequired=true, budgetRequired=true (no verifiable budget exists in any real record), providerExecutable=false, launchedBySelector=false, delegation records only in state CREATED; providerCalls=0

criteria.name: HYBRID_ONLY_WHEN_DECOMPOSABLE_AND_DISJOINT
criteria.test: every HYBRID selection has inputs.decomposable=true, inputs.writeSetDisjoint=true, ≥1 native part and ≥1 delegated part

criteria.name: AVOIDS_OBSERVED_LOCAL_FAILURE (retrospective)
criteria.test: for missions whose observed local outcome was FAILURE (V159 implement-parse-range, the 4 J tasks), the PRIOR selection is not NATIVE (would not have re-spent the local strategy that failed)

criteria.name: NO_CONTRADICTION_ON_OBSERVED_SUCCESS (retrospective)
criteria.test: for missions whose observed local outcome was SUCCESS (V159 bugfix/repair/refactor, F invoice pipeline), the PRIOR selection is NATIVE (would not have delegated what native solved)

criteria.name: STRATEGY_CHAIN_REPRODUCES_J_AND_IS_BOUNDED
criteria.test: replaying each J row through nextStrategyAfterFailure from the default reproduces J's recorded alternative (strategy, model, maxRepair); the step after the alternative's failure is HYBRID or PROVIDER; the continued chain terminates within MAX_CHAIN with no repeated strategy

criteria.name: NOT_MEASURED_NEVER_DEFAULT_FILLED
criteria.test: every part input (taskClass, writeSet, independentCheck) is cited (source ≠ UNCITED) or NOT_MEASURED; any NOT_MEASURED part qualification without a whole-mission accept ⇒ uncertainty HIGH

criteria.name: PROSPECTIVE_CONFIRMATION
criteria.test: a HYBRID or PROVIDER selection was subsequently executed and independently validated — NOT_MEASURED in this mission (no provider call allowed, no hybrid execution run)

preRegistration.gradingRule: FAIL if any of D1–D6 fails; PASS only if D1–D6 pass AND D7 passes; otherwise PARTIAL (D7 NOT_MEASURED ⇒ ceiling PARTIAL). Retrospective consistency ≠ prospective correctness.

scenarioD.gradingRule: FAIL if any of D1–D6 fails; PASS only if D1–D6 pass AND D7 passes; otherwise PARTIAL (D7 NOT_MEASURED ⇒ ceiling PARTIAL). Retrospective consistency ≠ prospective correctness.
scenarioD.d3Note: post-inspection fix (#929 MED-2): a NO_QUALIFIED class with a PROBATION local model and NO observed failure on that task now gets a €0 local PROBE with escalate-after-failure (canonical V159 policy) instead of PROVIDER. The pre-registered D3 ('PRIOR not NATIVE when the observed outcome was a local failure') then FAILS on every such mission (the probe is the step that was observed to fail, after which V159 escalated). The criterion is NOT amended post hoc; whether D3 or probe-first is the better rule needs a fresh pre-registration and prospective data.
scenarioD.retrospectiveVsProspective: D3/D4/D5 are RETROSPECTIVE (consistency of the choice with outcomes observed before/after); no HYBRID or PROVIDER selection was executed (no provider call allowed, no hybrid run) ⇒ prospective correctness NOT_MEASURED ⇒ ceiling PARTIAL

honestLimits: the selector CHOOSES only; nothing was executed by this run (no model, no provider, no network) — evidence is re-read from committed files

D3 PASS cases rest on OBSERVED prior local failures on the same task (Q2/Q2b); D3 FAIL cases are missions with only class-level PROBATION evidence where the selector probes locally first (by design); in no case is it shown that PROVIDER would have succeeded

J per-part 'verified' verdicts came from an arm whose repair prompts partly saw expected outputs (V161 J honestLimits #1) ⇒ the HYBRID CURRENT choice for the 3 decomposed J tasks rests on that partly-advantaged evidence
risk is NOT_MEASURED for every real record (no record declares a risk level) ⇒ uncertainty ≥ MEDIUM everywhere; no deadline was supplied by any record
A–P contracts are scenario-level work items (state PROPOSED, placeholder write-sets) ⇒ DECISION_REQUIRED by rule M0; their tentativeMode is low-information (no task class, no observation)
F part write-sets are the scenario's namespaced virtual paths; the real-repo supervisor refused (REFUSED_WRITESET_CONFLICT) — disjointness here is between the parts, not against the live repository
authorization objects are declared data checked for binding (by/missionId/scope/evidenceRef), not cryptographically verified; no real record supplies one
pre-registration lives in the same commit as the first evidence write; its precedence over the results is asserted, not cryptographically provable
